name: PlantUML diagrams
description: Technical fixture for PlantUML diagrams (diagram syntax "plantuml"), one slide per kind OPF draws: a sequence diagram, a class diagram, a state diagram, an activity diagram, a use case diagram, a component diagram, a mind map and a gantt chart. OPF reads the PlantUML itself and pele draws each as the Mermaid family of the same kind.

slides.title: The API answers every request with findings

diagram.source:
@startuml
actor Author
participant "Deck API" as API
database Store
Author -> API : POST /decks
API -> Store : save
Store --> API : id
alt valid
  API --> Author : 201 Created
else invalid
  API --> Author : 422 findings
end
@enduml

slides.title: A deck is a list of slides
A deck moves from draft to published

diagram.source:
@startuml
[*] --> Draft
state "In review" as Review
Draft --> Review : submit
Review --> Draft : changes
Review --> Published : approve
Published --> [*]
@enduml

slides.title: Every brief is reviewed before it is built
The editor and the site share one API
